name: rust monster
desc: Rust Monster is a CR 0.5 monstrosity.

actions.name: iron scent
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

actions.name: rust metal
actions.desc: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is destroyed after dealing damage. Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.WJsxqbHU28D64lWT.Item.dobpPU4kb00zSkQt.ActiveEffect.iqyGcqOolg6tFCwC]{Rusted Weapon} enchantment to a weapon, granting it a cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls each time the enchantment is applied.

actions.name: antennae
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} corrodes a nonmagical ferrous metal object it can see within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=4kalmKCyvd5GxuYh]] of it. If the object isn't being worn or carried, the touch destroys a 1-foot cube of it. If the object is being worn or carried by a creature, the creature can make a [[/save]] saving throw to avoid the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s touch. If the object touched is either metal armor or a metal shield being worn or carried, its takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to the AC it offers. Armor reduced to an AC of 10 or a shield that drops to a +0 bonus is destroyed. If the object touched is a held metal weapon, it rusts as described in the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.WJsxqbHU28D64lWT.Item.dobpPU4kb00zSkQt]{Rust Metal} trait. Foundry Note You can apply the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.WJsxqbHU28D64lWT.Item.dobpPU4kb00zSkQt.ActiveEffect.iqyGcqOolg6tFCwC]{Rusted Weapon} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.WJsxqbHU28D64lWT.Item.yxwZ9AtLMKZ61sTz.ActiveEffect.pbQsiyOC531v0z64]{Rusted Armor} enchantment to a weapon or armor, granting it a cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls or the AC it offers each time the enchantment is applied.
